items.briefing:
Nation-state cyber attackers are increasingly using AI to make their attacks faster and more sophisticated, according to a new warning from TrendAI — a concern directly relevant to Australian organisations including RTOs that hold sensitive student data. Separately, a compromised AI model on the Hugging Face platform has affected multiple victims beyond the initial breach, highlighting risks when staff use or integrate third-party AI tools without proper vetting.

With AI tools expanding rapidly — including ChatGPT's new researcher access in Australia — it's a good time to review which AI platforms your team is using. **Practical tip:** Only use AI tools approved by your organisation, and report any unexpected behaviour immediately to your IT contact.

featured.title: AI boosts nation-state cyberattacks, TrendAI warns
featured.quote: State-backed hackers using AI pose accelerating threat to Australian critical infrastructure and organisations.
